# Optees

Optees is an open-source desktop optimization toolkit for Linear Programming,
Mixed-Integer Linear Programming, and Knapsack models.

- Website: https://pablo-gitub.github.io/optees/
- Repository: https://github.com/Pablo-gitub/optees
- Releases: https://github.com/Pablo-gitub/optees/releases
- Roadmap: https://github.com/Pablo-gitub/optees/blob/main/docs/PROJECT_ROADMAP.md
